corrections: First draft computed nominal_unit_ms as q/1000, which reported 0.1 ms for step=10. Corrected to 1000/q with an explicit core-clock condition and a regression check; the integer q/N/LOAD values were never wrong.
scope_limits: The three clock_variable values are software inputs / .data initial values, NOT decoded PLL outputs.
USB-side 6-case comparison concluded all three configurations decode to 64MHz; that PLL decode has NOT been reproduced for nonUSB here.
No PLL lock, RCC switch transition, interrupt latency, lost ticks or wall-clock deadline is modelled.
No firmware execution, no device/account/network access.
